text.p: Ascent Entertainment Group Inc said late Wednesday it had restated its 1995 financial results in a Securities and Exchange Commission filing that increased its 1995 fiscal year loss to $21.0 million, or a loss of $0.87 per share.
The 1995 net loss had been $19.5 million, or $0.80 per share, before the filing.

The company said in a release that it restated its 1995 results after determining that "certain adjustments related to film inventory and a film distribution agreement should be made to the 1995 financial statements."

It said the restatement decreased its earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization (EBITDA) to $37.2 million from $40.8 million for all of 1995 and to $3.4 million from $7.0 million for the fourth quarter of 1995.
For fourth quarter 1996, the company reported a net loss of $19 million, or $0.64 per share, compared to a restated net loss in the 1995 fourth quarter of $7.9 million, or $0.32 per share.
